commands.upgrade: Update template-derived files to latest version

options.agent: --agent <name>  AI agent to use (default: config defaultAgent)

options.stdout: --stdout        Print result to stdout (no file write)

scan.desc: Analyze source code and generate analysis.json.

options.reset: --reset [cats]  Clear entry hashes (all or comma-separated categories)
options.stdout: --stdout        Print result to stdout (no file write)
--stdout    Show line change counts per file

options.id: --id <id>           Process only the {{text}} directive with this ID
options.perDirective: --per-directive     Legacy mode: one AI call per directive (default: batch per file)

forge.desc: Iteratively improve docs with an AI agent.

options.reviewCmd: --review-cmd <cmd>     Docs review command (default: sennel docs review)
options.dryRun: --dry-run              Skip file writes, review, and agent calls (1 round)

forge.perFileNote:
When the provider has systemPromptFlag set, the agent is called asynchronously per file.
Concurrency is configurable via config.json limits.concurrency (default: 5).

review.descDetail: Defaults to ${SENNEL_WORK_ROOT}/docs when no argument is given.

changelog.descDetail: Defaults to ${SENNEL_SOURCE_ROOT}/docs/change_log.md when no argument is given.

agents.descDetail: Resolves agents.flow and agents.project directives (PROJECT is refined by AI).

options.dryRun: --dry-run   Print generated content to stdout without writing

flow.desc: Run the Spec-Driven Development flow automatically.

options.title: --title <text>     Spec title (defaults to start of request)
options.spec: --spec <path>      Use existing spec (directory / spec.json / legacy spec.md)
options.noBranch: --no-branch        Create spec only without creating a branch
options.worktree: --worktree         Create a git worktree for the spec (.sennel/worktree/<branch>/)
options.dryRun: --dry-run          Run all subcommands in dry-run mode
